name: Great Baddow Recreation Ground Toddler Playground
text: The toddler playground at Great Baddow Parish Council's recreation ground off Baddow Road, Great Baddow; the ground also has an outdoor gym, table tennis and a tree trail.

name: Great Baddow Recreation Ground Junior Playground
text: The playground for older children at Great Baddow Parish Council's recreation ground off Baddow Road, Great Baddow, next to a separate toddler playground.
